item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i don sgrab snying gi khrag rlon
item.coloph: ces rig 'dzin chen po stong rgyung mthu chen gyi/ don gyi sgrub pa snying gi khrag rlon 'di nyid/ shar grol smin gling du rang nyid gcig pur yod pa'i nyin snang la/ nyi ma'i dkyil du rig 'dzin stong rgyung sku nyung 'bru tsam zhig gsal tha ler 'dug pa de yis khyed rang la bon skal du sbyin zer nas gdams pa 'di nyid brgyud cing gnang ba'o/ 'di sngon bka' bab bstan pa'i gsal byed me gsas rol gar gar dbang bdud 'dul snying po dang*/ 'di nyid kyi lung babs bon skal du snang ba'i snying grogs dge rgan shes rab phun tshogs gnyis nas dar dkar dri med kyis sna drangs nas yang yang bskul ba dang / yang slob btsun chung g.yung drung phun tshogs nas dar dkar gsang gos yug ring gis sna drangs te bskul ba la brten nas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus su bstan pa'i srog 'dzin gdul dka'i 'gro ba 'dul mdzad 'chi med nam mkha' sgron gsal thugs kyi rol gar mngon par snang ba'i tshe dbang bde chen snying po 'am gsang ba'i ming nas g.yung drung thog med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag sprang phal pa ci lta bu des/ rlung sems zung 'jug nyams len snang sems lha skur shar ba'i thun mtshams la/ shar grol smin gling du rig 'dzin stong rgyung mngon zhal mjal ba'i nyin par spel zhing brgyud pa'o/ dam med dred po bka' rkun dam nyams sde la rlung phyogs tsam las ma bsgrags par shin tu gsang rgya dam par gyis/ u ya//
